_comment: Post-processing after run_stage.sh stages 1-8, from production out/ + submission/episodes to the packed Track 1 file. Every step reads the previous step's episodes dir and writes a full copy (experiments/<run>/<step>/episodes). Steps are applied in this order by track1/postprocess.py. Episode-specific settings come from user-confirmed physical facts (static objects, the hoop at the feet) or from per-episode gates logged in docs/EXPERIMENTS.md.

steps.name: smooth_objects
steps._why: stage 7 lam_t 1000 (tuned on the Track 2 test set; Kaggle phys_v4) with production's stage-8 placement pinned

steps.name: stools_static
steps._why: user: stools 24 and 26 never move (Kaggle stool_static)

steps.name: desk_static
steps._why: user: desk static in the first half of ep 10 and until the end of ep 11 (onset detected)

steps.name: hoop_ep1
steps._why: tracker lost the held hoop; image ellipse + hand (H10)

steps.name: hoop_floor
steps._why: a ring lying flat on the floor sits at the soles (H12 generalised; derives ep 0's x1.193 from 169 flat frames, leaves 1/2 unchanged)

steps.name: joint_fit
steps._why: J: whole-video object refinement; per-episode gates

steps.name: pen_objects
steps._why: push objects off the hands (phys_v4); foam may shrink (two-hand squeeze)

steps.name: pen_hands
steps._why: H4: move hands, not objects (Kaggle phys_v6: PEN 0.0150 -> 0.0091 with CD-O -0.085)
